title.en: The Prince of Wales and the pancakes

subtitle.zh-TW: 不澆花等於做了別的事嗎？吃鬆餅會不會也成了盆栽枯死的原因？
subtitle.en: Is not watering the same as doing something else? Would eating pancakes then be a cause of the plant's death?

story.zh-TW: 考慮王子與盆栽的情境。女王請威爾斯王子每天下午為她心愛的盆栽澆水，王子卻決定不去，改在宮裡吃燕麥鬆餅度過下午，盆栽因缺水枯死。王子的待辦清單把澆花排在第二位：假如他沒有吃鬆餅，就會去澆花。
story.en: Consider a prince and a potted plant. The Queen asks the Prince of Wales to water her favourite plant every afternoon, but he decides not to, and spends the afternoon in the palace eating oatmeal pancakes instead. The plant dies of thirst. Watering is second on his to-do list: had he not been eating pancakes, he would have watered it.

zh-TW.sentence: 女王請威爾斯王子每天下午為她心愛的盆栽澆水，王子卻決定不去，改在宮裡吃燕麥鬆餅度過下午，盆栽因缺水枯死。
王子的待辦清單把澆花排在第二位：假如他沒有吃鬆餅，就會去澆花。

en.sentence: The Queen asks the Prince of Wales to water her favourite plant every afternoon, but he decides not to, and spends the afternoon in the palace eating oatmeal pancakes instead. The plant dies of thirst.
Watering is second on his to-do list: had he not been eating pancakes, he would have watered it.

text.zh-TW: 要說的是王子沒有澆花，而不是他吃了鬆餅；吃鬆餅本身與盆栽枯死無關。
text.en: What is blamed is his not watering, not his eating pancakes; the pancakes themselves have nothing to do with the plant's death.

explanation.zh-TW: 模型用 E 表示王子吃鬆餅（外生），W 表示王子澆花，依待辦清單 W = ¬E；盆栽枯死是沒有被澆（D = ¬W）。由於「沒澆花」在模型裡就等於「吃了鬆餅」，所有理論都把 E = 1 與 W = 0 同時算作 D = 1 的原因，直覺卻只接受後者。這正是 Sartorio 所說的「多餘的積極原因」：把不作為化約成做了別的事，會得到多餘的積極原因。王鵬翔 (2019) 以對比因果論處理：吃鬆餅而非澆花是原因，吃鬆餅而非看戲則不是。本引擎不含對比，故 agree 為空。模型依故事擬定。
explanation.en: E is the Prince eating pancakes (exogenous), W is his watering the plant, following the to-do list: W = ¬E; the plant dies if it is not watered (D = ¬W). Since not watering is the same event as eating pancakes in the model, every theory counts E = 1 and W = 0 alike as causes of D = 1, while the intuition accepts only the latter. This is Sartorio's problem of unwanted positive causes: reducing an omission to doing something else yields superfluous positive causes. Wang (2019) answers with contrastive causation: eating pancakes rather than watering is a cause, eating pancakes rather than going to the theatre is not. The engine has no contrasts, so agree is empty. The model is built from the story.

sources.citation: Wang, P.-H. (2019). Problems of hypothetical thinking in causal judgments about omissions [Bu zuowei yinguo panduan zhong de jiashexing sikao wenti; in Chinese]. EurAmerica, 49(3), 287–340.

note.zh-TW: p.293 轉述 Sartorio (2010: 259) 的威爾斯王子問題一（多餘的積極原因），問題二（多餘的消極原因）自 p.293 延續到 p.294。Sartorio (2010) 原文未取得，此處只據王鵬翔的轉述。
note.en: P. 293 relays Sartorio (2010: 259), the first Prince of Wales problem (unwanted positive causes); the second (unwanted negative causes) runs from p. 293 to p. 294. Sartorio (2010) itself was not available; this follows Wang's report.

label.en: The Prince does not eat pancakes
